curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a determined magistrate dismantle an untouchable heroin syndicate before its ruthless underworld swallows him whole?
curatedMovie.description: Transferred to Marseille to crack down on organized crime, magistrate Pierre Michel targets the French Connection, an entrenched heroin syndicate run by the seemingly untouchable Gaëtan Zampa.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful, and deliberate, pairing gritty crime atmosphere with focused, engaged pacing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Cédric Jimenez delivers a stylish, hard-hitting French crime thriller that turns a classic underworld pursuit into a tense, high-stakes duel across Marseille.
